permutation_test.formula_explanation: Minimum possible p-value with 200 permutations: (0 + 1) / (200 + 1) = 0.004975 (~0.0050), indicating zero null iterations exceeded the observed AUC.

covariates_only_model.description: Standardized age and sex demographic covariates alone (Logistic Regression)

paired_bootstrap_vs_covars.conclusion: Non-significant (p = 0.2685, 95% CI spans zero: [-0.1038, +0.1714]). Functional connectivity does not statistically outperform demographic covariates alone.

limitations.title: Meta-Selection Confound
limitations.detail: The 118-subject clean subset and hyperparameter search space (Pearson/Partial/Tangent, k in {50, 100, 200}) were curated after exploratory analyses on the same data.

limitations.title: Permutation Test Conditions on Narrowed Grid
limitations.detail: The permutation test validates that the selected pipeline beats chance for the narrowed 126-configuration grid, but does not repeat the initial space exploration or cohort selection.

limitations.title: Non-Significant Separation from Demographics
limitations.detail: While the final candidate achieves LOIO AUC 0.6253 (p=0.0050), the paired bootstrap difference against the Age/Sex-only baseline (ΔAUC = +0.0400 [-0.1038, +0.1714], p=0.2685) is not statistically significant.
